title: TikTok: Eric on Novo Nordisk's non-profit board and the invention of insulin and GLP-1
summary: Eric posts an Incorruptible TikTok lifting one of the book's most striking case studies — a 100-year-old pharma company protected by a non-profit board, founded by one of Denmark's first female doctors and her Nobel Laureate husband, that invented both insulin and the modern GLP-1 drugs.
blockquote:
This story will bend your mind about the invention of GLP-1 drugs and insulin by a 100 year old pharma company and protected by their non-profit board. Founded by one of Denmark's first female doctors and her Nobel Laureate husband.
The full story is in my new book Incorruptible. On sale now.
